title: Cone Of Shame
subject: a man whose beagle comes home from the vet wearing a plastic cone after a minor operation and spends the week bumping into doorframes, the coffee table and the cat
caption: 90s Eurodance revival. Detuned supersaw synth stabs on the offbeats, rolling octave-jumping bassline, four-on-the-floor 909 kick with open hi-hats, a classic rave piano riff in the choruses. Big glossy club mix with wide synths and a punchy compressed kick. Female lead with a bright powerful mezzo on the choruses, male deadpan spoken-rap verses. 134 BPM, A minor. Bouncy, silly and euphoric. No trap, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no acoustic guitar, no slow ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - rave piano and supersaw stabs]

[Verse 1 - male rap]
Brought him home from the vet at three
Plastic satellite round his head
Hit the doorframe, hit my knee
Hit the cat, the cat hit back

[Pre-Chorus]
Bonk, bonk, here he comes

[Chorus]
Cone of shame
Bouncing off the walls
Cone of shame
Wagging down the hall

[Verse 2 - male rap]
Can't reach the bowl, so I hold it up
Can't fit through the flap at night
Scoops the crumbs up like a plough
Thinks he's got a radar dish

[Pre-Chorus]
Bonk, bonk, mind the lamp

[Chorus]
Cone of shame
Ringing like a bell
Cone of shame
Ten more days of hell

[Bridge - piano breakdown]
Friday morning, cone comes off
He just stands there, feeling light

[Outro - supersaw fade]
Cone of shame
Bonk, bonk, goodnight
